lines.zh: 你听见的低语，是我在抽气。
lines.en: That whispering you hear is me drawing breath.
Blood tears behind me. Don't step.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌踩在落叶上，没有声。
lines.en: My feet on dead leaves make no sound.
My sobbing arrives before my steps.
Don't look back; my footsteps are wet.

lines.zh: 走廊够长，够我哭着走完。
lines.en: The hall is long enough to cry my way down.

lines.zh: 血泪一直流，我数着步子。
lines.en: Blood tears keep falling. I count the steps.

lines.zh: 我抽了口气，声音卡在喉咙。
lines.en: I gasp, and the sound catches in my throat.

lines.zh: 我贴着门缝，光割着我的脸。
lines.en: I press to the door crack; the light cuts my face.
I walk slower than my weeping.

lines.zh: 影子先到，脚步随后就到。
lines.en: My shadow arrives first; my steps follow.
I weep as I follow you.
Crying and counting, I reached a thousand.

lines.zh: 这堵墙以前是能推开的。
lines.en: This wall could be pushed open once.
I wept so long my face ran.
My shadow crouches in the doorway, weeping.
I sit and weep. I never left.

lines.zh: 墙里有人在数数，数错了。
lines.en: Someone in the wall is counting, and counting wrong.

lines.zh: 楼上有人走，可楼上没人。
lines.en: Someone walks upstairs, but upstairs is empty.

lines.zh: 静得能听见我的泪落地。
lines.en: It's so quiet I can hear my tears land.

lines.zh: 墙角有只眼睛，不是我的。
lines.en: There's an eye in the corner, and it isn't mine.
The shadow weeps softly on the floor.
I don't blink, and my tears won't dry.
I've forgotten who I'm waiting for.
I remember that face of yours.
The clock has stopped, and I'm still crying.

lines.zh: 你身上有我眼泪的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of my tears.

lines.zh: 你也叫 John？那我记住了。
lines.en: You're John too? Then I'll remember you.
Your eyes shine from behind the door.

lines.zh: 血泪流到下巴了，你看我。
lines.en: Bloody tears reach my chin — look at me.
That sound just now — it was you.
Stand and talk a moment; I won't chase.

lines.zh: 你在帘子后面，我看见了。
lines.en: You're behind the curtain — I see you.

lines.zh: 第一次看清你的脸，真清楚。
lines.en: The first clear look at your face — so clear.
When the sobbing stops, you should run.
Bloody tears have gummed my eyes.
Looking for the door? It's behind me.

lines.zh: 我血泪流到下巴，你还在装。
lines.en: My tears reach my chin, and you still pretend.

lines.zh: 别动，我只看一眼你的脸。
lines.en: Stay still; I only want one look at your face.

lines.zh: 血泪挡着眼睛，我还是看着你。
lines.en: Bloody tears blur my eyes, and still I watch you.

lines.zh: 你的手抖得比我的哭声还快。
lines.en: Your hands shake faster than my sobbing.
The tears I shed are red.
I lift my head and you step back.

lines.zh: 我站在你背后，你已经站了很久。
lines.en: I stand at your back, and you've stood there long.

lines.zh: 你这张脸，我在梦里见过。
lines.en: I've seen that face of yours in my dreams.

lines.zh: 血泪流到下巴，我还在看你。
lines.en: Blood tears reach my chin, and I still watch you.
This tear is blood. I will remember.
My tears still fall, and I'm still standing.

lines.zh: 哭成这样，骨头还是硬的。
lines.en: I weep like this, and my bones are still hard.

lines.zh: 别打了，我的血泪滴个不停。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; my bloody tears keep dripping.
The blood on your fingers is mine.

lines.zh: 我的眼泪是红的，你看清了吗。
lines.en: My tears are red; did you see?
The blood on my face dries and flows again.
I don't cry out; I only draw one breath.
Done crying, and still standing.
Crying this long has soaked my face.
The rust at the corner of my eye never stops
My mouth is open, waiting for you.

lines.zh: 你手一松，东西就落下了。
lines.en: Your hand loosened, and the thing fell.

lines.zh: 我的泪落在地上，是红的
lines.en: My tears hit the floor red
The shadow—this looks like mine.
I reach one finger out, just to touch the edge.
My tears are red — don't wipe them.

lines.zh: 那点亮，能照见我的脸吗？
lines.en: Will that little light show my face?

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，能让我不哭吗？
lines.en: Will that thing in your hand stop my tears?

lines.zh: 举起来，让我看看那是什么。
lines.en: Hold it up and let me see what it is.
The room is just too narrow — not your fault.
One touch, and the bloodstain will remind you.

lines.zh: 别推我，你手上会有红印。
lines.en: Don't push me; your hand will come away red.
Slide along the wall and back off quietly.

lines.zh: 撞上了，你留住了一滴泪。
lines.en: You bumped me — you've kept one of my tears.
Even through cloth, I can count it.

lines.zh: 看着像水，撞上来是骨头。
lines.en: I look like water, but I hit like bone.

lines.zh: 你不该撞进我的哭声里。
lines.en: You shouldn't have walked into my weeping.
Don't step there — the shadow is wet underneath.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀是热的，我记住了。
lines.en: Your shoulder is warm; I've remembered it.
This face of mine is always crying.

lines.zh: 我们不用心跳，也能靠在一起。
lines.en: We don't need heartbeats to lean together.
My tears are red — do not wipe them.

lines.zh: 把手给我，握一会儿就好。
lines.en: Give me your hand — just hold it a while.

lines.zh: 你答应得这么快，我倒哭了。
lines.en: You agree so fast that it makes me weep.

lines.zh: 我哭的时候，眼泪是红的。
lines.en: When I weep, the tears run red.
We're both John. That's enough.

lines.zh: 两个人在一间屋里，藏得住。
lines.en: Two in one room can stay hidden.
My tears ran dry. I'm still chasing.
I can wait. Years, if needed.

lines.zh: 你越走，地上的东西越多。
lines.en: The farther you walk, the more lies on the floor.

lines.zh: 这件，我只拿一件，血还在滴。
lines.en: Just this one, and blood still drips from it.

lines.zh: 眼泪是血色的，擦不干净。
lines.en: My tears are blood-red and never wipe clean.
This shadow is as damp as mine.
Picked up — and I go back to crying.
Was this yours? I'll cup it in my hands.

lines.zh: 我把它摆在窗台上，你来找。
lines.en: I laid it on the windowsill — come find it.

lines.zh: 它会记得我碰过这块骨头。
lines.en: It will remember I touched this bone.

lines.zh: 它在我手里凉了，像我的脸。
lines.en: It cools in my hand, like my face.
You dropped this; I wiped it clean.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有活人的热气。
lines.en: I smell the living warmth on you.

lines.zh: 你的心跳从墙那边传过来。
lines.en: Your heartbeat comes through the wall.
Once you run, my sobbing follows you.
That breath you just stopped — perfect.

lines.zh: 我在门口等了你一整晚。
lines.en: I waited at the door for you all night.
My tears are dripping onto you.

lines.zh: 我的眼泪是红的，你别看。
lines.en: My tears are red; do not look.

lines.zh: 声音到这儿就停了，是你。
lines.en: The sound stops here — it's you.

lines.zh: 我的眼泪是红的，一直在流。
lines.en: My tears are red and never stop.
I've memorized your footsteps.
Only you, and that is enough.
Hold still, let me see you clearly.
Tears of blood. I am crying.

lines.zh: 你肩膀动了，我知道是你。
lines.en: Your shoulder moved; I know it's you.
Start now, and do not stop.

lines.zh: 我哭的时候，眼里流的是血。
lines.en: When I weep, blood runs from my eyes.

lines.zh: 你跑得越急，我哭得越响。
lines.en: The faster you run, the louder I weep.

lines.zh: 你鞋掉了一只，没敢回头捡。
lines.en: You lost a shoe and didn't dare go back for it.
I'll catch up, sooner or later.

lines.zh: 柜门关不严，缝里是你的气。
lines.en: The cabinet won't shut; your breath leaks through.
Turn left, and I'm already on the left.
No hurry — my tears got there first.
Your breathing is louder than your steps.

lines.zh: 我哭着，两句话都在流血。
lines.en: I weep, and both mouths bleed.
The lamp's still on; you won't get far.
My tears wet the floorboards.
Each gasp of yours brings me one step closer.
The door is locked, so I'll weep for you.
Stop a moment and let me dry my tears.
Three steps behind you — I'm right here.

lines.zh: 拐角那块暗，我站了一夜。
lines.en: I stood all night in the dark of that corner.
Bloody tears leave a line on the ground.
You looked back first.

lines.zh: 你鞋跟敲地的声音真清楚。
lines.en: The tap of your heels on the floor is so clear.
I don't run; my weeping runs for me.

lines.zh: 别跑那么快，血泪糊眼了。
lines.en: Don't run so fast — my tears blur it.

lines.zh: 哭声停下的时候最危险。
lines.en: The dangerous moment is when the crying stops.

lines.zh: 我哭到一半，手已经掐住。
lines.en: Halfway through my weeping, my hand has you.

lines.zh: 我的指尖碰到你的衣角了。
lines.en: My fingertip caught the hem of your coat.

lines.zh: 把手举起来，让我看清楚。
lines.en: Raise your hands and let me see clearly.

lines.zh: 躲什么，我哭得手都软了。
lines.en: Why dodge? My crying has made my hands weak.
Once it's over, I won't have to cry.

lines.zh: 别叫，会引来楼上的东西。
lines.en: Don't scream — it will draw what's upstairs.

lines.zh: 对不起，我一哭就想抓人。
lines.en: Forgive me — when I cry, I want to grab.
Don't shout — I'll only wail louder.
When I weep, my hands won't stop.
My tears are red.
My hand is out. Don't dodge.
Stand still. Let me see you.
Just one, and don't hold it against me.

lines.zh: 哭声这么大，你怎么睡得着。
lines.en: With sobbing this loud, how do you sleep?
You looked at me first — don't blame me.

lines.zh: 哭了一整夜，眼角全是锈。
lines.en: Cried all night; rust fills the corners of my eyes.
My shadow is still upstairs.
My bloody tears hiss on the ground.

lines.zh: 开始吧，我眼泪已经准备好了。
lines.en: Let's begin; my tears are ready.
Someone's beyond the wall — I heard them.

lines.zh: 又回到这条走廊，还是湿的。
lines.en: Back in this hallway, and it's still damp.
Hello — I hide my face in my hands.

lines.zh: 我连自己叫什么都忘了。
lines.en: I've forgotten even my own name.
I squeeze out from behind the wallpaper.
When I weep, it is very quiet.
When I weep, the hallway grows.
Whose breath is so light — playing asleep?

lines.zh: 屋里就你一个，我数过了。
lines.en: You're alone here — I counted.

lines.zh: 我从走廊尽头来了，别回头。
lines.en: I've come from the end of the hall — don't look back.

lines.zh: 灯亮着，我的泪就擦不干。
lines.en: With the lamp lit, my tears won't dry.
This room's smell — I know it.
I cried all night and my throat is raw
May I stand in the doorway?

lines.zh: 天还亮着，我先在墙角等。
lines.en: It's still light; I'll wait by the corner.

lines.zh: 这里暗得正好，我不用眨眼。
lines.en: It's dark enough here; I needn't blink.
Burn. I smell like firewood.
I fall, and my face hits the ground first.
Water is coming in.

lines.zh: 火药炸得我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The gunpowder leaves my ears ringing.
Even weeping, I feel pain.
Spells echo inside my bones.
I have been hungry a long time.
Lightning still clings to my bones.
My tears drift up; I fall down.
